svg.title: ON/OFF control of the cold room
svg.desc: Refrigeration starts ON at 4 degrees Celsius, switches OFF when the temperature falls below 2 degrees at 10.3 seconds and then reverses at almost every 0.1 second update, also while the door is open; the zoom shows nine reversals in one second while the temperature moves less than 0.03 degrees.
svg.text: ON/OFF control of the cold room

then it switches back and forth
